component.script: function report(p) as object out("deeper.aliasField", [fieldOf(m.top, "childMaxHeight")]) m.top.childMaxHeight = 42 out("deeper.findChild", [show(m.top.findNode("child"))]) out("deeper.real", [show(m.real)]) return invalid end function sub init() m.real = m.top.getChild(1).getChild(0).getChild(0) end sub
